example_sentences_in_bangla: পূজার সময় ঠেকাঠেকি এড়িয়ে চলতে হয়।
সে ঠেকাঠেকি করে কাজ করে যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: During the puja, one must avoid any touching.
He works while being careful not to touch anything unnecessarily.
note: Refers to ritualistic avoidance of contact in Hindu practices common in Bengal.
